Executive-branch opacity nevertheless could hide facts, especially around access and PRF records.","duplicate_reporting":"High record-level duplication risk: the compact index uses WEB-/E- IDs while the manifest recreates the same source-locator-claim facts as WD001–WD016 rather than retaining one global stable ID. Adverse material is substantial; favorable/limiting material includes the transition, audit reservations, archived inquiries, police conclusion, dissenting opinions, and lawful/security explanations (WEB-7B-013, WEB-7B-014, WEB-7B-015, WEB-7B-C1-001, WEB-7B-C1-010). The search still lacked a developed affirmative record for voluntary correction, costly candor, or independently verified remediation.","missing_source_type":"Primary full judgments and case files for the coup, TSE cases, MEC matter, and campaign-account disposition; an authenticated Bolsonaro-specific asset disclosure and forensic source-of-funds/campaign-finance record; and independent evidence of personal direction, knowledge, or tolerance for PRF/MEC conduct.","official_claim_independence":"Official judicial, audit, and administrative sources are strong for their own findings but are not mutually independent when they summarize the same proceedings.
